name: Adzuna
summary: Job ads aggregated across 19 countries, with salary statistics: search listings, salary histograms and history, vacancies by region and the top hiring companies.

app_id.description: Your Adzuna application ID (developer.adzuna.com > Dashboard). Sent as the app_id query parameter.

app_key.description: Your Adzuna application key, from the same page. Sent as the app_key query parameter.

notes: Without an Accept header the API answers JSONP; this entry sends Accept: application/json.
The free key is for evaluation. Commercial use is a 14-day trial, then needs a licence from Adzuna; limits per plan show in your account.
Search returns only a snippet of each job description, and redirect_url points to the ad on Adzuna.
Salaries are in the country site's own currency; a job with salary_is_predicted set carries an Adzuna estimate, not an advertised figure.

endpoints.name: Search job ads
endpoints.summary: Job ads in one country by keywords, place, category, salary, contract type and company, with title, company, location, salary and a description snippet.

country.description: Adzuna country site, lowercase ISO code.

what_phrase.description: An exact phrase in the title or description.

what_or.description: Keywords of which any may appear, space-separated.

title_only.description: Keywords matched in the title only.

where.description: Centre of the search: a place name or postcode.

distance.description: Radius around where, in kilometres; default 5.

location0.description: Top level of an Adzuna location path, e.g. UK; add location1..location7 to narrow (location0=UK, location1=South East England, location2=Surrey).

location1.description: Level 1 of the location path; see location0.

location2.description: Level 2 of the location path; see location0.

location3.description: Level 3 of the location path; see location0.

location4.description: Level 4 of the location path; see location0.

location5.description: Level 5 of the location path; see location0.

location6.description: Level 6 of the location path; see location0.

location7.description: Level 7 of the location path; see location0.

max_days_old.description: Oldest ad age to return, in days.

category.description: Category tag from adzuna.categories.list, e.g. it-jobs.

salary_min.description: Minimum salary, in the country's currency.

salary_max.description: Maximum salary, in the country's currency.

salary_include_unknown.description: Set to 1 to keep ads without a known salary when filtering on salary.

full_time.description: Set to 1 for full-time ads only.

part_time.description: Set to 1 for part-time ads only.

contract.description: Set to 1 for contract ads only.

permanent.description: Set to 1 for permanent ads only.

company.description: Canonical company name, as returned in a job's company object.

notes: page is in the path and starts at 1; results_per_page sets the page size.
